links.comparator_used: Algorithms trained on the original cohort and applied to the geographically-distant hospital without additional training
links.outcome: Discriminative accuracy (AUC) for predicting antibiotic susceptibility at the external hospital
links.effect: AUC 0.70-0.93 after training on the distant hospital's antibiogram vs AUC 0.69-0.87 without additional training
links.quote: When the algorithms were trained on the antibiogram from the geographically-distant hospital, the accuracy improved (AUC 0.70-0.93).

design_hint: local retraining/recalibration on local antibiogram before deployment
